versions.changelog:
- Initial release of generate-perler-bead-pindou skill.
- Generate 2D Perler Bead (Pindou) patterns from text prompts and/or reference images.
- Returns a list of Perler Beads/Pindou brand color codes, plus a workspace URL for pattern instructions.
- Supports custom board sizes and popular bead brands: default, mard, artkal, perler, hama.
- Includes example usage for easy integration into Node and Python environments.
